name: 58102 · Fargo, ND
findings: ZIP 58102 (Fargo) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58102 (Fargo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 58102 (Fargo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
